title: Two forecasts, both wrong
description:
A straight line and a growth curve, both fitted to India's solar power 2015 to 2019, forecast 92 and 681 TWh for 2025. It was 196.

See forecasts scored against reality every day, free: https://models.rimilab.com/#/models/forecast-check

Data: Ember and Energy Institute, via Our World in Data (CC BY 4.0).
